description: A long-term survival community with Java & Bedrock cross-play. Build, explore, and find your home in YaoYunXuanQi.
body:
# YaoYunXuanQi | A Place to Call Home

## English

Looking for a Minecraft server where you can truly settle down and build your own story?

YaoYunXuanQi, operated by the TuoYu Server Management Team, is a long-term survival community focused on creating a friendly, stable, and welcoming experience for every player. Whether you're playing on Java Edition or Bedrock Edition, you can seamlessly join the same world and embark on your adventure together.

We preserve the essence of vanilla survival while enhancing gameplay with carefully selected quality-of-life features. From building your dream home and exploring the wilderness to developing light technical projects and enjoying a peaceful community atmosphere, everyone can find their own way to play.

### Features

• Full Java & Bedrock Cross-Play Support  
Play together across PC, mobile phones, and tablets without barriers.

• Stable Dual-Node Infrastructure  
Optimized network deployment helps reduce latency and disconnections, providing a smoother experience for players from different regions.

• Vanilla-Oriented Survival Experience  
Enjoy the authentic Minecraft survival gameplay while benefiting from convenient enhancements.

• Light Technical & Casual Friendly  
Balanced settings allow both technical players and casual builders to enjoy the server without excessive grinding.

• Long-Term Operation  
24/7 uptime with no planned world resets, ensuring your creations and memories can stand the test of time.

• Community First  
Clear rules, fair management, and responsive support create a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

At YaoYunXuanQi, Minecraft is more than just a game.

It's a place to meet friends, create memories, and build a home together.

Join us, and begin your next adventure.

---

# 拓域·瑶云轩栖｜在这里，找到属于你的家园

## 中文

想寻找一个能够真正安家、长期发展的 Minecraft 世界吗？

由拓域服务器管理组运营的「拓域·瑶云轩栖」，是一座以长期生存为核心理念的社区服务器。我们致力于为每一位玩家打造稳定、友善、舒适的游玩环境。无论你使用 Java 版还是基岩版，都能够进入同一个世界，与来自不同设备的伙伴并肩冒险。

我们保留原版生存最纯粹的乐趣，同时通过精心挑选的轻量化功能提升整体体验。无论是建造理想家园、探索未知大陆、体验轻量生电玩法，还是与朋友一起养老闲聊，你都能找到属于自己的节奏。

### 服务器特色

• Java 与基岩版无缝互通  
电脑、手机、平板均可加入，同一世界共同游玩。

• 双节点稳定部署  
优化网络连接，有效降低卡顿与掉线，为不同地区玩家带来流畅体验。

• 原版导向生存玩法  
保留采集、探索、建造等核心乐趣，在不破坏原版体验的基础上提供便利功能。

• 轻生电 · 轻养老  
兼顾技术玩家与休闲玩家需求，不肝不卷，也能享受成长与创造的快乐。

• 长期运营 · 永不轻易删档  
服务器全天候开放，珍视每位玩家的努力与回忆，让每一份建筑与故事都能被长久保存。

• 社区至上 · 公平管理  
完善的规则体系、公开透明的管理机制，以及及时的反馈响应，共同维护良好的游戏环境。

在「拓域·瑶云轩栖」，Minecraft 不只是游戏。

它是一次相遇、一段旅程，也是无数玩家共同守护的家园。

愿你在这里，遇见志同道合的伙伴，留下属于自己的故事。
